        1. Stimulate rapid light fluctuations between 45 lux and 75 lux (e.g., 45 lux for 1 second, 75 lux for 1 second, repeat for 10 cycles).

      Fail: |
        - The system activates or deactivates the Low Beam Headlights during the rapid fluctuations.
        - The system fails to activate the lights when stabilized at 45 lux for > 2 seconds.
        - The system fails to deactivate the lights when stabilized at 75 lux for > 5 seconds.

- VC_Item:
